x: In second place James McIlroy smashed the Northern Irish record. In all there were five closely contested 800s and a couple of 1500s which were almost as tight.

With Windsor’s James McIlroy in the field it was unlikely that anyone was tipping Tim Bayley as the 800 metres winner – but win he did – grabbing the lead while McIlroy faded, ultimately to drop out, and holding on grimly all the way to the finish.

… maelstrom of flying feet and jabbing elbows it was the Bristol & West and Gateshead vests showing ahead with Windsor’s James McIlroy and Stockport’s Steve Vernon in the second rank; but Stephen Sharp was close at hand, sparring with Andy Baddeley of Harrow and half a dozen others in the tightly bun…
